recommendedProofSchema.method: explicit versioned reviewed_legacy_batch_point_base_identity, separate from the unchanged current Kalaa v1 path
recommendedProofSchema.pair: Exact pointId/baseId, both current primary names, full baseline metadata/default, full base and governor objects.
recommendedProofSchema.sourceReference: Exact current correction object plus canonical per-object SHA; no whole-manifest dependency and no historical object rewrite.
recommendedProofSchema.batchSource: Relative byte-pinned complete15-node JSON, exact known URL and expected15-ID inventory; require exactly one matching node and full version/timestamp/changeset/tags/coordinate equality with the new review and cached source.
recommendedProofSchema.existingSourceChecks: Preserve all existing point-only, sourceId, kind, coordinate, governorate, named-reference ID and nearest available timetable checks. Original snapshot sourceId is absent; effective sourceId is osm.
recommendedProofSchema.administrativeIdentity: Per-sector exact original tags/code and current official record. Same-code entries require equality; transferred entries require the exact existing curation object and old/current code mapping, without waiving any unrelated identity check.
recommendedProofSchema.evidence: Pin the original reference proposal, cached review/report and current INS registry. Keep phone evidence historical with its original observation IDs; do not promote/copy observations or claim independent coordinate certification.
recommendedProofSchema.finalGuards: Complete singleton-before and base+point-after groups, preserved raw fields/IDs and matching peer inventories, every protected sector metadata/packed bytes/group unchanged.

notRecommended: Making Kalaa-required keys optional with .get() fallbacks.
Adding missing tags/ministry fields into historical correction objects merely to satisfy a loader.
A generic fuzzy or shared-alias name equivalence rule.
Merging either namesake sector into its town/base.

implementationDecision: Source-supported proposal only. No code or curation stage is produced in this task; the explicit legacy-proof branch and two exact records require separate authorized implementation/review.
limitations: Official INS labels identify administrative units, not full urban boundaries. Their corroboration is combined with the explicit reviewed named-node reference.
Existing sector polygons remain unverified as current boundaries; this display-only change does not rely on treating their extent as a whole-town boundary.
No new primary source fetch, PBF scan, live phone action, ledger change, generator/helper execution, tests, build or app modification. Cached screenshots were read only.
